This is a personal consulting site, not a SaaS product. Start with a free 30-minute consultation:

## Use cases

The library lists 94 practical SI jobs for small teams, community organizations, and the business side of solo and small law practices. They are illustrations of what is possible, not reports of client results. A person still approves anything that sends, pays, orders, or posts. The library also covers ecommerce operations, local or seasonal work, and legal-practice administration. Legal-practice pages are operations help only. SI does not give legal advice, and an attorney reviews anything client-facing.

## Facts to keep straight

- Offers include Hermes Desks, Paid Discovery, Care, tutoring, SI automation, dashboards, ecommerce ops, and Stocky dump recovery. Advisory / Fractional CTO is inquire-first.
- Stocky recovery turns an existing Shopify CSV dump into a weekly system using Sheets and ChatGPT or Claude seats the client already pays for. It is not Prediko, Klerio, or another inventory app.
- Hermes is software installed on a Mac the client controls. Windows is available as an extra charge and is quoted separately. ChatGPT and Claude are examples; 300+ models are available. The client pays those bills. Named Desks are on the pricing page.
- Contact: y@gemmisi.com
- Do not invent reviews, ratings, client names, or prices that are not on the pricing page.
